name: gotmpl-rainbow
description: Depth-based rainbow colouring of Go template control keywords, driven by the tree-sitter grammar and queries/rainbow.scm.
author: Gary Miller <garym@nettex.com.au>

gotmplRainbow.parserPath.description: Absolute path to tree-sitter-gotmpl.wasm. Leave empty to use the parser bundled with the extension.

gotmplRainbow.rainbowQueryPath.description: Absolute path to queries/rainbow.scm. Leave empty to use the query bundled with the extension.

gotmplRainbow.highlightsQueryPath.description: Absolute path to queries/highlights.scm (drives theme-based syntax highlighting). Leave empty to use the query bundled with the extension.

gotmplRainbow.semanticHighlighting.description: Provide tree-sitter-driven syntax highlighting (semantic tokens) from highlights.scm for gotmpl files. Colours come from the active theme. Turn off to keep only the rainbow keyword colouring.

gotmplRainbow.colors.description: Rainbow palette for dark themes (also the fallback for light themes when gotmplRainbow.colorsLight is empty). Nesting depth wraps around the list.

gotmplRainbow.colorsLight.description: Rainbow palette for light themes — darker/more saturated so colours like yellow stay readable on a light background. Leave empty to reuse gotmplRainbow.colors. Nesting depth wraps around the list.

gotmplRainbow.bold.description: Render the coloured keywords in bold.

gotmplRainbow.border.description: Draw a rounded outline around each rainbow keyword, in its depth colour.

gotmplRainbow.background.description: Fill each rainbow keyword with a faint background tint of its depth colour.

commands.title: Go template rainbow: Reload parser and query
